segments.text: Hello friends, welcome to your channel HSC study guide.
segments.zh: 朋友们好，欢迎来到你们的频道 HSE Study Guide。

segments.text: In this video, we are going to talk about the MCQ test of Work at height.
segments.zh: 在这个视频中，我们要讲的是高处作业的选择题测试。

segments.text: In this, we are going to test the safety knowledge of your work at height.
segments.zh: 在这里，我们要测试你们的高处作业安全知识。

segments.text: So let's start the video.
segments.zh: 那我们开始视频吧。

segments.text: The first question is, what is the meaning of working at height?
segments.zh: 第一题是：高处作业是什么意思？

segments.text: For that, option A is that working at or above 1.8 m height is called as work at height.
segments.zh: 为此，选项 A 是在 1.8 m 或以上高度作业称为高处作业。

segments.text: Option B is that wherever there is a risk of falling, it is also called as work at height from one level to another in the lower level.
segments.zh: 选项 B 是凡是存在从一个高度坠落到另一个较低高度风险的地方，也称为高处作业。

segments.text: Option C is that any hole or opening of any floor or ground.
segments.zh: 选项 C 是任何楼面或地面上的任何孔洞或开口，

segments.text: So the risk of falling below is called as work at height.
segments.zh: 有向下坠落风险的，称为高处作业。

segments.text: And option D is all these.
segments.zh: 选项 D 是以上全部。

segments.text: So the correct answer from this is to select you.
segments.zh: 所以你要从中选出正确答案。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option D all of the above.
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 D，以上全部。

segments.text: Then the question is that which height the fall protection system requires.
segments.zh: 下一题是：多高的高度需要坠落防护系统？

segments.text: So option A has been given for that, option B is 1.8 m, option C is 2.8 m, option C is 1.5 m and option D is 4 m.
segments.zh: 为此给出的选项 A，选项 B 是 1.8 m，选项 C 是 2.8 m，选项 C 是 1.5 m，选项 D 是 4 m。

segments.text: So the correct answer is to select you.
segments.zh: 所以你要选出正确答案。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option A 1.8 m.
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 A，1.8 m。

segments.text: Then the next question is that who is prohibited from working at height.
segments.zh: 下一题是：哪些人禁止从事高处作业？

segments.text: So option A is that the workers who do not have fall protection.
segments.zh: 选项 A 是没有坠落防护的工人。

segments.text: Option B is that workers who have health problems like heart disease, psychosis or epilepsy etc.
segments.zh: 选项 B 是患有心脏病、精神病或癫痫等健康问题的工人。

segments.text: Option C is that the workers who do not have a personal fall arrest system.
segments.zh: 选项 C 是没有个人坠落防护系统的工人。

segments.text: And option B is all these.
segments.zh: 选项 B 是以上全部。

segments.text: So the correct answer of this is to select you.
segments.zh: 所以你要选出这道题的正确答案。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option B that any workers who have health problems are.
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 B，任何有健康问题的工人。

segments.text: Then the next question is that what are the thousands of working at height.
segments.zh: 下一题是：高处作业有哪些危害？

segments.text: So for that option A is height 1000, option B is unprotected age, option C is fragile roof or degraded material.
segments.zh: 为此，选项 A 是高度 1000，选项 B 是无防护的边缘，选项 C 是易碎屋面或老化材料。

segments.text: And option D is all these.
segments.zh: 选项 D 是以上全部。

segments.text: So the correct answer of this is to select you.
segments.zh: 所以你要选出这道题的正确答案。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option D all of the above.
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 D，以上全部。

segments.text: Then the next question is that for working at height, the special PPEs are categorized.
segments.zh: 下一题是：高处作业有专门分类的个人防护装备，

segments.text: So which PPEs are those.
segments.zh: 是哪些个人防护装备？

segments.text: So option A is safety helmet, option B is hand gloves or goggles, option C is full body harness.
segments.zh: 选项 A 是安全帽，选项 B 是手套或护目镜，选项 C 是全身式安全带，

segments.text: That too with connector and anchorage.
segments.zh: 而且要带连接件和锚固点。

segments.text: And option D is high visibility waist.
segments.zh: 选项 D 是高可见度背心。

segments.text: So the correct answer of this is to select you.
segments.zh: 所以你要选出这道题的正确答案。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option C full body harness with connector and anchorage.
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 C，带连接件和锚固点的全身式安全带。

segments.text: Then the next question is that what is the validity of personal fall arrest equipment.
segments.zh: 下一题是：个人坠落防护装备的有效期是多久？

segments.text: So option A is one year, option B is six months, option C is three year and option D is three months.
segments.zh: 选项 A 是一年，选项 B 是六个月，选项 C 是三年，选项 D 是三个月。

segments.text: So the correct answer of this is to select you.
segments.zh: 所以你要选出这道题的正确答案。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option B six months.
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 B，六个月。

segments.text: Then the next question is that if the permanent anchor point is not on the roof, then what will you do to anchor your harness.
segments.zh: 下一题是：如果屋顶上没有永久锚固点，你要怎样固定你的安全带？

segments.text: So option A is that a person can hold the lanyard.
segments.zh: 选项 A 是可以让一个人拉住系索。

segments.text: Option B is that the lifeline can be used.
segments.zh: 选项 B 是可以使用生命线。

segments.text: Option C is that the safety net can be provided.
segments.zh: 选项 C 是可以设置安全网。

segments.text: And option D is that none of them.
segments.zh: 选项 D 是以上都不是。

segments.text: So the correct answer of this is to select you.
segments.zh: 所以你要选出这道题的正确答案。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option B that we can use the lifeline there.
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 B，我们可以在那里使用生命线。

segments.text: Then the next question is that what are the three fall protection systems.
segments.zh: 下一题是：三种坠落防护系统是什么？

segments.text: So option A is full body harness, anchorage and connectors.
segments.zh: 选项 A 是全身式安全带、锚固点和连接件。

segments.text: Option B is top rail, mid rail and tow board.
segments.zh: 选项 B 是顶部栏杆、中间栏杆和踢脚板。

segments.text: Option C is safety net, harness and lifeline.
segments.zh: 选项 C 是安全网、安全带和生命线。

segments.text: And option D is none of them.
segments.zh: 选项 D 是以上都不是。

segments.text: So the correct answer of this is to select you.
segments.zh: 所以你要选出这道题的正确答案。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option B top rail, mid rail and tow board.
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 B，顶部栏杆、中间栏杆和踢脚板。

segments.text: Then the next question is that what is the first preventive measure against the workout height.
segments.zh: 下一题是：针对高处作业的首要预防措施是什么？

segments.text: So option A is personal fall harness system.
segments.zh: 选项 A 是个人坠落防护安全带系统。

segments.text: Option B is lifeline system.
segments.zh: 选项 B 是生命线系统。

segments.text: Option C is that we have to try to avoid the work of the workout height.
segments.zh: 选项 C 是我们要尽量避免高处作业，

segments.text: By providing any alternative solution with it.
segments.zh: 同时提供替代方案。

segments.text: And option D is guard rail system.
segments.zh: 选项 D 是护栏系统。

segments.text: So the correct answer is to select you.
segments.zh: 所以你要选出正确答案。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option C that we have to avoid the work of the workout height.
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 C，我们要避免高处作业，

segments.text: We have to try it there.
segments.zh: 要在那里尽量做到这一点，

segments.text: And for that we have to provide the alternative solution there.
segments.zh: 为此我们要在那里提供替代方案。

segments.text: And then the next question is that how can we prevent the material from falling from the height.
segments.zh: 然后下一题是：我们怎样防止物料从高处坠落？

segments.text: So option A is to provide the tow board.
segments.zh: 选项 A 是设置踢脚板。

segments.text: Option B is to secure the loose material there.
segments.zh: 选项 B 是在那里固定好松散的物料。

segments.text: Option C is to use the hand tools strap and tools bag.
segments.zh: 选项 C 是使用手工具绑带和工具袋。

segments.text: And option D is all of them.
segments.zh: 选项 D 是以上全部。

segments.text: So the correct answer of this is to select you.
segments.zh: 所以你要选出这道题的正确答案。

segments.text: So the correct answer of this is option D all of the above.
segments.zh: 这道题的正确答案是选项 D，以上全部。

segments.text: So friends I hope that through this video you must have come to know about the basic safety knowledge of the workout height.
segments.zh: 所以朋友们，我希望通过这个视频，你们已经了解了高处作业的基本安全知识。

segments.text: So that's all for today.
segments.zh: 今天就到这里。

segments.text: See you in the next video.
segments.zh: 我们下个视频再见。

segments.text: Till then take care.
segments.zh: 在那之前请多保重。

segments.text: Bye Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
